meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 用户提供 cmem.ai 的同步令牌、用户 ID 和 SyncHub URL 后,Claude 会把这些凭据写入插件配置文件(必要时也写入本机设置),并运行状态检查确认配置成功,且不会在对话中泄露令牌。
howto.when: 当你说“setup claude-mem”“connect cmem”等,或提供 cmem.ai Connect 的令牌/用户 ID/SyncHub URL 时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置 claude-mem,这是我的连接令牌 cm_abc123
say.note: 会提取令牌并写入配置,不会回显令牌

say.text: 把 claude-mem 和 Cowork 配对
say.note: 会引导你提供 cmem.ai Connect 的三项信息

say.text: 这是我的 cmem 用户 ID 和 SyncHub 地址,帮我配置好
say.note: 如有缺失会先向你索要同步令牌

howto.what_en: After the user provides a cmem.ai sync token, user ID, and SyncHub URL, Claude writes these credentials into the plugin config (and optionally local settings), then runs a status check to confirm setup while never exposing the token in chat.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "connect cmem", etc., or supplies cmem.ai Connect values such as token, user ID, or SyncHub URL.

say_en.text: Set up claude-mem with this connection token: cm_abc123
say_en.note: It extracts and stores the token, never echoing it.
It will guide you to provide the three cmem.ai Connect values.

say_en.text: Here are my cmem user ID and SyncHub URL, configure them
say_en.note: It asks for the sync token if it is missing.
